name: China Changbaishan International Holdings Limited
summary: China Changbaishan International Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the property development and management business in the People's Republic of China. It operates through Property Development and Management, and Changbaishan Resources Business segments. The Property Development and Management segment develops properties and provides management services, including planning, designing, budgeting, licensing, contract tendering, and contract administration. The Changbaishan resources business segment cultivates and sells ginsengs assets naturally grown under forest land, mineral water, and other products in Changbaishan region, Jilin Province.
